newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius share index eases as leading stocks fall.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius share index eases as leading stocks fall.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Mauritius SEMDEX market index eased 0.25 points to 391.25 on Friday amid declines in leading stocks, brokers said.
Turnover was posted at 6.24 million rupees on 219,943 shares from 14.29 million rupees on 398,702 shares on Wednesday.
Brokers blamed the lower index on falls in stocks of leading companies amid market uncertainty. "The future of capital market will depend on the next budget's contents," a broker said.
In the banking sector, Mauritius Commercial Bank lost 50 cents to 88.50 rupees on 5,200 shares and the State Bank of Mauritius was stable at 13.00 rupees on 118,100 shares.
British American Insurance was unchanged to 8.45 rupees on 150 shares and Swan gained 30 cents to 46.10 rupees on 1,120 shares.

In the hotel sector, Sun Resorts lost 60 cents to 49.40 rupees on 15,400 shares, New Mauritius Hotels climbed 80 cents to 37.00 rupees on 1,000 shares and Grand Baie Hotel remained to 46.00 rupees on 700 shares.

Conglomerates Rogers was 2.00 rupees lower to 106.00 rupees on 3,050 shares and Ireland Blyth Ltd rose 40 cents to 16.40 rupees on 10,650 shares. Shell gained 20 cents to 20.50 rupees on 3,000 shares.

In the sugar sector, Harel Freres remained to 54.00 rupees on 722 shares, The Mount was stable at 23.60 rupees on 2,000 shares and Mon Tresor Mon Desert lost 40 cents to 41.40 rupees, but was not quoted.
The national carrier Air Mauritius was unchanged to 41.00 rupees on 6,874 shares.
